description.p: Chilpa plays your music library, your own media servers and sources added by plugins from one window. It shows the format that reaches the output device and says whether playback is bit-perfect or what changed the signal on the way.

ul.li: FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, DSF, DFF, MP3 and Ogg Vorbis, with CUE sheets and SACD disc images
Jellyfin, Plex, Subsonic-compatible and DLNA/UPnP media servers beside local files
Multiple queues, playlists, and search across the library and connected sources
Refine narrows the library by artist, genre, year, composer, label, rating, quality or source, and saves the query
Synchronized lyrics with translations, and immersive views that react to the audio
Listening statistics that stay on your computer, with export to CSV or PNG
Plugins for internet radio, podcasts and an equalizer with listening presets
A command line opened with :, and configurable keyboard shortcuts

description.p: Chilpa sends no telemetry. Online lookups for metadata, artwork and lyrics can be switched off, and offline mode blocks every network request.

screenshot.caption: An artist page with popular tracks, the latest release and similar artists
A queue and the route of the current track to the output device
The immersive view with synchronized lyrics

description.p: Genres, composers and compositions, and media servers in both directions.

ul.li: A genre tree with an image for 1,182 genres, a Composers view with changeable portraits, and Compositions that open on the classical repertoire with each work's composer, period and form
Plex, Jellyfin and OpenSubsonic playlists, favorites and star ratings stay in step with the server, and DLNA/UPnP servers can be a library source
Tracks, albums and playlists from a self-hosted music server can be made available offline
Scrobbling to Koito, Libre.fm and a GNU FM server, and a Recap page in Stats
Protect my library keeps Chilpa from changing music files or servers
More search options, a customizable sidebar, a hardened playback engine and general performance work
Radio asks for the cover once per song instead of on every audio write, and the cover comes back after a reconnect
Native DSD through PipeWire plays on a real DAC again; it needs PipeWire 1.6 or later, and older versions get DSD converted to PCM
A fresh install no longer loses saved credentials when two parts of Chilpa create their own install id at the same time
Audio outputs are listed away from the window, which no longer freezes while the sound server answers
The theme follows the desktop on sessions where Qt reports none, such as Hyprland
Third-party plugins show their publisher, and older versions of a plugin can be installed
Edits to records from your own servers are kept on this device
A server sign-in is no longer lost at the next start of a fresh install
Source settings have a numbered setup wizard

description.p: First public release: local libraries and connected sources in one interface, with multiple queues, playlists, album editions, search, synchronized lyrics with translations, immersive views and an official plugin catalog that works offline.
